name: Exp_Oracle
summary: This EA trades based on the custom Oracle indicator, offering three signal modes: zero-line breakthrough, signal line direction change, and indicator/signal line crossover. It opens buy/sell positions with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and can independently control entry and exit permissions for long and short positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Oracle指标进行交易，提供三种信号模式：零线突破、信号线方向变化和指标与信号线交叉。它通过可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈水平开立多空仓位，并可独立控制多空方向的入场和出场权限。
strategy_analysis: 策略基于自定义Oracle指标生成交易信号，该指标包含主线和信号线两个缓冲区。EA提供三种入场算法：breakthrough模式检测信号线穿越零轴；twist模式检测信号线方向反转；disposition模式检测主线与信号线的交叉。入场信号仅在检测到新K线时计算，避免重复交易。出场条件通过买入/卖出平仓权限控制，当反向信号出现时平掉对应仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。止损和止盈分别设为1000点和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，并通过Recount机制在数据不足时重试。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy generates trading signals based on the custom Oracle indicator, which features two buffers: a main line and a signal line. The EA offers three entry algorithms: breakthrough mode detects when the signal line crosses the zero axis; twist mode detects when the signal line changes direction; disposition mode detects crossovers between the main line and signal line. Entry signals are only calculated on new bar detection, preventing repeated trades within the same bar. Exit conditions are controlled by buy/sell close permissions, closing opposite positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing is managed via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Stop loss and take profit are set at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are computed only once per bar, with a Recount mechanism to retry when data is insufficient.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例(正值)或固定手数(负值)
parameters.description_en: Money management: negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供三种灵活的入场算法模式，适应不同市场行情
止损和止盈设置合理，风险回报比为1:2
使用新K线检测机制避免同根K线重复交易
多空方向的开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，灵活性高
通过IsNewBar和Recount机制确保数据完整性和信号可靠性
pros_en: Offers three flexible entry algorithm modes to adapt to different market conditions
Reasonable stop loss and take profit settings with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio
Uses new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar
Buy and sell open/close permissions can be independently controlled for high flexibility
Ensures data integrity and signal reliability through IsNewBar and Recount mechanisms
cons: 依赖自定义Oracle指标，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
止损1000点过大，在短线交易中可能导致较大亏损
缺乏加仓和减仓机制，仓位管理较为单一
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生虚假信号
Recound_重绘参数为true时可能导致信号回溯偏差
cons_en: Depends on a custom Oracle indicator whose internal logic is opaque, making signal validation difficult
Stop loss of 1000 points is excessively large, potentially causing significant losses in short-term trading
Lacks position scaling mechanisms, making money management rather simplistic
No spread filter, which may generate false signals in high-spread environments
The Recount_ redrawing parameter set to true may cause signal lookback bias
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，避免在高点差时段入场
加入移动止损或追踪止损功能，以保护已有利润
增加多时间框架确认机制，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to avoid entering during high-spread periods
Implement a trailing stop feature to protect accumulated profits
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 止损1000点较大，可能导致单笔亏损过高
重绘模式(Recount_=true)可能造成信号前视偏差
缺乏点差过滤和滑点保护不足
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is large, potentially resulting in excessive single-trade losses
Redrawing mode (Recount_=true) may cause signal look-ahead bias
Lacks spread filter and insufficient slippage protection

It opens buy/sell positions with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and can independently control entry and exit permissions for long and short positions.
